description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements a logging utility wrapping Android's native Log class within a custom logger interface. It provides methods for logging messages with different priorities and chaining log nodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's Log utility to conform to the LogNode interface, supporting chained logging nodes and message formatting.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a given priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable, then propagates it to the next log node if present.
